about.title: Software built around your marketing needs
about.subtitle: Zirodm is a digital product company focused on developing innovative software for digital marketers
description: We combine marketing expertise with an engineering-driven approach to create tools that address real challenges, simplify complex workflows, and make everyday operations more efficient.
We are building Zirodm step by step, starting with LinkSentinel and working toward a connected ecosystem of marketing tools.

mission.title: Making marketing operations simpler
mission.subtitle: Making marketing operations simpler
description: Digital marketing involves countless repetitive tasks and operational challenges.
From monitoring links and managing domains to handling campaign infrastructure, marketers often spend valuable time on processes that could be simpler.

goal.title: Our goal is to build tools that take this complexity off your hands.
bullets: Save time by reducing repetitive tasks.
Stay in control of their marketing infrastructure.
Work more efficiently with purpose-built tools.
Focus on growth instead of operational overhead.

mission.current: Zirodm is currently in an active development stage. We are working on new solutions that will gradually become part of a connected ecosystem designed to support different aspects of digital marketing.

items.title: LinkSentinel
items.subtitle: Keep your marketing links in check
description: LinkSentinel helps affiliate marketers monitor their links and domains, detect potential issues, and keep their traffic destinations under control.
Whether you're managing a few campaigns or a growing portfolio of domains, LinkSentinel helps you stay informed about the health of your marketing links.
